title: Felix and the Asset
author: S. M. Vasquez
blurb: Isandro Kavanagh, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
